claim: The drawn-week clause of Find's timing has three statements. §12.5 (base l. 17232–17234): "each change of the drawn week re-evaluates the chips' listing … off the scrub's path, within ≈ 100 ms of the frame being drawn …, the frame never waiting for it". T120-6, rewritten this round (l. 18773–18775): "… the chips re-evaluated within ≈ 100 ms of that frame being drawn, the frame never waiting for them". R12-35 (l. 17582) names its measure as "V12 §3.15.10's `time.findSuggest` and `time.findGlow` (… and from a scrubbed week's frame being drawn)", with the bar "… ≤ 100 ms (T120-6; T-ER-25), the frame never waiting for Find". V12's statistic, rewritten this round, times only the interval from a drawn week's frame to its chips' re-evaluated glow (§3.4.2's row l. 1173, §3.15.10's bullet l. 2643). T-V12-52 (l. 3176) takes T120-6, but its only planted case is "a planted re-evaluation drawn more than 100 ms after a scrubbed week's frame". A build that re-evaluates the chips on the scrub's path makes the frame wait; the glow is then drawn with the frame, so `time.findGlow` reads about 0 ms and passes. V06 §6.4's frame budgets (V06 l. 3900–3903) are stated and measured without Find: a cached METROPOLIS frame of ≤ 120 ms absorbs a short re-evaluation, and the ≤ 800 ms image path a long one. V09 §6.4's Find row (V09 l. 4314–4317) defers to "V12's T-V12-52 reports T120-6". So the clause has no measure, against R6-04's "neither states a clause the other lacks". R12-35's register row names a measurement that V12's statistic, as specified, never takes, so two builders of the statistic build different code (R6-01's grade for this group; VAP-r2-11's). A wrong build also passes every bar. MAJOR.
required_change: V12, three statements; the cell and the rest of each row stand. (1) §3.4.2's catalogue row `time.findSuggest`, `time.findGlow` (l. 1173): after "drawn to its chips' re-evaluated glow drawn (from the later of M5 and V06's E6)" add "; with the re-evaluation delayed test-side by 2 s, that frame still drawn within V06 §6.4's frame budget at the METROPOLIS cap and its glow after it — the frame never waiting for the re-evaluation (§12.5; T120-6)". (2) §3.15.10's T120-6 bullet (l. 2643): "— the latter from the later of M5 and V06's E6)" → "— the latter from the later of M5 and V06's E6, that frame never waiting for the re-evaluation)". (3) T-V12-52 (l. 3176): after "fails `time.findGlow`'s" add ", and, with the chips' re-evaluation delayed test-side by 2 s, a scrubbed frame drawn past V06 §6.4's budget (a re-evaluation run on the scrub's path) fails its frame clause".
